## IsPlainTextMimeType(string?) {#Sisk_Core_Helpers_MimeHelper_IsPlainTextMimeType_System_String_}

Gets a value indicating whether the specified MIME type is a plain text MIME type.

```csharp
public static bool IsPlainTextMimeType(string? mimeType)
```

### Parameters

`mimeType` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

The MIME type to check.

### Returns

[bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

[`true`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) if the MIME type is a plain text MIME type; otherwise, [`false`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool).
